title: Guidelines & Disclaimers
content:
Back from the dead (haha) and slowly revamping my old translations for the current fanbase.
DO:

Screenshot portions of my translation to share with others, as long as it's proofread. I don't need or require credit in every instance, but if you could link back to this website, it would help others find the rest of the translation.
Use my translations for wikis, masterlists, and other community projects. You don't need to ask me for permission.
Use my translations for quotebots, story analysis, or any other such discussions.
Translate my work into another language entirely. I used to have a hard stance against this, but if you could either link my translation or mention that it's a translation of a translation somewhere in your work, I would really appreciate it. I tend to localize things in my work far more than I used to.

DON'T:

Use my translations for profit in any way, shape, or form. These are entirely unofficial.
Alter the intent of the script for anything malicious, please.

If you have any inquiries, please ask here.
Credits
A big thanks to Ren for providing the plugins and layout, and 310mc for holding my hand when it comes to figuring out where I was going wrong. Assets are from Ensemble Stars!! Wiki, Gradualcolors, or screenshotted by myself.
